reason: I've had a dry cough, headaches, and aches for three days.
diagnosis: Most likely COVID-19 or another viral upper respiratory infection, suggested by acute dry cough, headache, myalgias, feverish feeling, and diarrhea with no focal chest or throat symptoms.
keyPoints: Onset and sequence of symptoms: cough first, then headache, myalgias, feverishness
COVID exposure risks: work contacts, masking, household contacts, travel, known sick contacts
Respiratory red flags: shortness of breath, chest pain, sputum, hemoptysis, loss of smell/taste
GI symptoms and hydration: diarrhea, nausea/vomiting, appetite change, ability to keep fluids down
Fever/systemic features: true temperature, chills, fatigue, night sweats
Past history and meds: comorbidities, immunocompromise, regular meds, allergies
Social history relevant to infection control: occupation, isolation, smoking/vaping, alcohol/drug use
